crossRefs.note: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

people.name: Kehelathah
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey

translations.web: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
translations.bsb: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
